heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution via operator override
reason: Integration-tier: drives resolve_core_root with the override env set; source is 'override' and no fallback is consulted.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution falls back to the governed-project checkout
reason: Integration-tier: a checkout carrying the COMPLETE core prose set resolves to source 'project_checkout'.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution rejects a non-core project checkout
reason: Integration-tier: a checkout shipping only generic prose is declined by rule 2 and falls through — never project_checkout, never the hard incomplete-core error.

heading: ## Scenario: an incomplete core checkout fails rather than falling back
reason: Integration-tier: a checkout with core-exclusive but incomplete prose yields kind core_checkout_incomplete rather than silently falling through to the installed cache.

heading: ## Scenario: the incomplete-checkout diagnostic names the recovery
reason: Integration-tier: the core_checkout_incomplete diagnostic names the LIVESPEC_CORE_PLUGIN_ROOT override as the recovery.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution selects the install record for this project
reason: Integration-tier: with a registry whose FIRST record is another project's, the resolver selects THIS project's record by projectPath, never by position.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution reports a projectPath mismatch as such
reason: Integration-tier: records present but none matching this project root yields kind project_not_installed, never a fall-through to another project's record.

heading: ## Scenario: an unreadable registry is not reported as core being uninstalled
reason: Integration-tier: an unreadable registry (OSError) yields kind registry_unreadable, a non-answer — never registry_absent / an install recommendation.

heading: ## Scenario: an absent registry yields the install instructions
reason: Integration-tier: an absent registry yields kind registry_absent whose diagnostic recommends installing core.
